name: Credit Based Schemes For SC - Term Loan (TL)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an entrepreneur of the Scheduled Caste Category. 1. The applicant should submit a viable project proposal for an income-generating activity. 1. The applicant should apply through a State Channelising Agency, Regional Rural Bank, Public Sector Bank, or other channelising agency associated with NSFDC. 1. The project proposal should be appraised and found viable by the concerned channelising agency.
